# ai-Quantum

> A-share liquidity-repair research notes for several trading days to several weeks, plus a pre-open checklist. Not a validated edge, not a live data product, not a general short-term framework for other markets, and not permission to order.

This file is a map of paths in this repository. It does not load those files, install `skills/*/SKILL.md`, start a job, or grant authorization. Ordinary Cursor and other agents do not auto-install `skills/*/SKILL.md` from a clone. Host safety rules and the user's own authorization still apply. Read the skills inside a complete clone; copying a skill directory out breaks links to `../../docs`. Canonical rules are not copied here. Discipline version `2026-11-14.3`; hold-versus-sell notes `2026-11-14.5`: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md). License: [MIT](LICENSE), copyright Frank Cheng, 2026. Documentation check: `python3 scripts/check_docs.py`. Passing this check does not validate trading performance. Hold-versus-sell arithmetic: `python3 scripts/hold_sell.py`. It does not validate trading performance. Missing, stale, conflicting, or unresolved-basis data still requires "check incomplete" (检查不完整).

## Start

- [Chinese README](README.md): human entry, maturity, and the steps that exist today
- [English README](README.en.md): the same facts in English
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): reading order, repository map, edit checks, and hard boundaries
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): documentation changes. Current version `2026-11-14.3`
- [Documentation check](scripts/check_docs.py): `python3 scripts/check_docs.py`. Passing this check does not validate trading performance
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 Frank Cheng. Redistribution keeps the copyright and permission notices

## Canonical documents

- [Strategy](docs/strategy.md): the discipline. Chinese. Do not treat the READMEs as a second copy
- [Trade record](docs/trade-record.md): one record, three separate answers, append only. Fields date from `2026-11-14.2`; discipline version is `2026-11-14.3`
- [Hold versus sell now](docs/hold-sell-compare.md): incremental net proceeds, not buy cost. A breakeven threshold is not a measured probability. `python3 scripts/hold_sell.py`
- [Synthetic walk-through](docs/examples/synthetic/README.md): frozen as-of examples. Not quotes or news
- [Liquidity repair skill](skills/liquidity-repair/SKILL.md): close, margin, peer, and VWAP recipes. Not a deployed job
- [Liquidity repair output](skills/liquidity-repair/output-template.md): entry, hold or exit, and review in separate sections
- [Indicator dictionary](skills/liquidity-repair/indicators.md): fields, units, and unresolved choices. Numeric examples are synthetic
- [Coverage](skills/liquidity-repair/coverage.md): confirmed discipline, original recipe, later extension, unresolved
- [Yizhongtian example](skills/liquidity-repair/examples/yizhongtian.md): public names 300308, 300502, 300394. No prices and no positions
- [Yizhongtian config](skills/liquidity-repair/examples/config.example.yaml): example configuration only
- [Trade plan template](docs/templates/trade-plan.md): blank card; filled copies stay private
- [Review template](docs/templates/review.md): blank card. Classify proposal, user-reported, and brokerage-verified executions separately
- [Evidence contract](docs/evidence-contract.md): cutoff, source status, facts, inference, gaps. Max data age is caller-supplied, not a validated default
- [Inventory](docs/inventory.md): historical ad hoc capabilities, the two skills, checks that stay inside them, and missing adapters
- [Maintenance](docs/maintenance.md): maintain a complete clone. Private routines in the original environment are not in this repository and are absent after a clone
- [300308 case](docs/cases/300308-2026-11.md): one authorized trade record. Not a proven edge, and not a source of universal price levels
- [Pre-open skill](skills/pre-open-overnight-risk-check/SKILL.md): checklist workflow, slug `pre-open-overnight-risk-check`
- [Source guide](skills/pre-open-overnight-risk-check/sources.md): candidate pages, not a connected integration
- [Output template](skills/pre-open-overnight-risk-check/output-template.md): blank pre-open record
- [Example configuration](skills/pre-open-overnight-risk-check/examples/config.example.yaml): public example only, not a holding and not a scheduler

## Status

There is no trading application, package manifest, install command, or live integration in this repository. Supported use is a complete clone. The documentation check is `python3 scripts/check_docs.py`. Passing this check does not validate trading performance. If core data is missing, stale, or conflicting, or a required calculation basis is unresolved, the overall conclusion must include "check incomplete" (检查不完整), list the affected judgments, and must not be written as if risk has been ruled out. The license is MIT: see [LICENSE](LICENSE).
